result.summary: Executed fn:git-merge for the ISS-105 token-model run. Verified the working tree compiled (zig build exit 0, no error-set issues) and unit tests passed (zig build test exit 0). During verification found a pre-existing memory leak in the migration runner (src/db/migrations.zig): schema_migrations version-string keys duplicated into the applied StringHashMap were never freed, leaking one allocation per applied migration on every provisionTenantSchema call (1424 leak reports, zig build test exit 1 on clean HEAD). Per Unblock-Everything, fixed the leak by freeing the keys on map teardown; zig build test now exits 0 with zero leaks. Committed engine refinements + leak fix and handoff bookkeeping to the feature branch, pushed, opened PR #82, and squash-merged into main with branch deletion. Repo returned to main with a clean working tree.
